_doc: Khuôn Reels (docs/specs/social-reels-templates.md): Ama/Carlos đọc mẫu tiếng Anh ≤150 wpm, chừa lặng cho người xem đọc theo (repeat), IPA lấy từ kho từ lúc dựng, chữ bản địa viết tay (native-qa).

items.native: 上の歯を下くちびるに当てます
items.gloss_en: Put your top teeth on your lower lip.

items.native: 強く読むのは2番目の音です
items.gloss_en: The stress is on the second sound.

items.native: lのあとに母音を入れません
items.gloss_en: Do not add a vowel after the l.

items.native: 最初のsとtの間に母音を入れません
items.gloss_en: Do not add a vowel between the s and t.

segments.text: Four words many learners say wrong. Listen, then repeat after me.

native.hook: カタカナ読みになりやすい4語
native.caption: カタカナのまま読んでいませんか？“vanilla”は唇の使い方、“banana”は2番目を強く読む、“film”と“strike”は母音を入れないのがコツです。Ama先生のあとに続けて言ってみよう。Lexkiteアプリで発音を練習。

en.hook: 4 words easy to read like katakana
en.caption: Are you reading them like katakana? The trick for “vanilla” is your lips, in “banana” you stress the second sound, and in “film” and “strike” you do not add vowels. Repeat after teacher Ama. Practice pronunciation in the Lexkite app.
